name: hub_crosswalk_wait
about: The crosswalk wait on sm_hub_1, live (0018/7; navigation-jump-links.md 'The crosswalk wait, walked' and 'The crosswalk walk'). The hub's logic_timer flips its two crosswalk hints (crosswalk_south, crosswalk_east_west: CAI_Hint::InputWalk 0x102d0a50 / InputDontWalk 0x102d0a80 -> 0x102f97c0 sets or clears a pair link's whole 0xf0 nibble) every 40 s. A use_interesting pedestrian going to a place across a road runs 0xff -> 0x100 SCHED_TROIKA_WALK_TO_INTERESTING_PLACE with a pedestrian goal (type 8); the pedestrian route 0x102fcd00 marks both curbs of a crossed pair (waypoint flags 0x24 / 0x20); arriving at the first curb while the link is red, 0x102a0bc0 (waypoint flag 4 AND goal type 8) sends it to the wait 0x102a0b90: AT_CROSSWALK and 0x102 SCHED_TROIKA_WAIT_AT_CROSSWALK (sched_troika_wait_at_crosswalk.sch: SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE IDLE_STAND, PAUSE_MOVING, FACE_NEXT_NODE, WAIT_INDEFINITE; interrupt COND_CROSSWALK_WALK), held until the next Walk raises COND_CROSSWALK_WALK and it walks on. The spine over five minutes of the hub at idle: a DontWalk, some pedestrian waiting at a curb, the program broken by CROSSWALK_WALK on the next Walk -- on the walker's next NORMAL think after it (0x102a0d20 raises CROSSWALK_WALK only there), which out of the player's PVS is up to 16 s away (lifecycle.md:340-343), so 'crosses' is within 17 s of the green.
notes: Q-V13c (record error, inferred): the crosswalk chain matches retail. 0x102a0d20 raises CROSSWALK_WALK only on a normal think, and out of the player's PVS retail's normal-think interval is x10, capped at 16 s (docs/vtmb/npc-ai/lifecycle.md:340-343, 'Normal: ... !PVS -> x10 cap 16'). The waiting pedestrian's own cadence is about 9.9 s, so its next think after the 40.833 green falls past the old 2 s deadline. 'crosses' within 17.0 = the 16 s cap plus the 1 s re-arm. The duration (300 s) already covers the observed run (green 40.833 + 17 = 57.8). Green in two boots, V13 final pass 2026-10-04 (arena 20261004T102327, 20261004T102849), the same trace both times: 11.833 crosswalk_south DontWalk; 23.917 male_asylum_patron break CROSSWALK_DONTWALK (0x13) -> SCHED_TROIKA_WAIT_AT_CROSSWALK (0x102); 40.833 crosswalk_south Walk; 43.550 break CROSSWALK_WALK (0x12) -> SCHED_TROIKA_WALK_TO_INTERESTING_PLACE (0x100), task_walk_path (2.717 s after the green).
